evidence.detail: Header has og:url via {{og_url}} but no <link rel='canonical'> tag anywhere in the template
Only deck and archetype views implement og_url; most pages have no canonical URL at all
Only hit is the alternate-name card redirect in card.mustache:4, not a <link rel=canonical> head element

triage.notes: Issue #1551 explicitly depends on this issue (bakert comment 'See #1566'). Scope includes URL design decisions (id vs. slug canonical), redirect logic, and adding canonical link tags across all page types.
